root.label: Nawrocki vetoes Poland's EU defense-loan legislation

events.label: Nawrocki vetoes Poland's EU defense-loan legislation

slots.name: EU loan amount
slots.sentence: Just last March, Poland's president Karol Nawrocki, who is backed by the PiS, vetoed legislation that would have allowed Poland to access almost 44 billion euros (55 billion dollars) in EU defense loans because German armaments companies could also have benefited.
